knowledge_cards.title: Midjourney 提示词基础结构与参数速查
knowledge_cards.content:
【可直接复制的 MJ 提示词骨架】
{主体描述}, {环境/场景}, {光线}, {构图/景别}, {风格/艺术家}, {色彩}, {质量词} --ar 16:9 --v 7 --s 250

【常用参数】
--ar 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 画幅比例
--v 7 模型版本（数字随官方更新）
--s 0-1000 风格化强度（越高越有艺术性）
--c 0-100 变化多样性
--no 负向排除：--no text, watermark
--seed 12345 固定种子复现结果

【示例（可直接复制）】
cinematic portrait of a young woman in neon-lit Tokyo street at night, rain reflections, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens, blade runner style, teal and magenta color palette, ultra detailed --ar 2:3 --v 7 --s 300

knowledge_cards.title: Midjourney 风格与艺术家关键词速查
knowledge_cards.keywords: MJ, 风格, 艺术家, styles
knowledge_cards.content:
【风格词库：直接追加到提示词尾部】
摄影类：documentary photography, editorial fashion photography, film grain, Kodak Portra 400
电影类：cinematic still, anamorphic lens flare, movie still
插画类：watercolor illustration, ink wash painting, flat vector illustration, children's book illustration
3D类：3D render, octane render, unreal engine 5, claymation, isometric 3D
艺术运动：art nouveau, ukiyo-e, cyberpunk, solarpunk, vaporwave, minimalist

【示例（可直接复制）】
a cozy bookstore interior, watercolor illustration, soft morning light, warm palette --ar 3:2 --s 180

knowledge_cards.title: Stable Diffusion / SDXL 正向提示词结构模板
knowledge_cards.keywords: SD, Stable Diffusion, SDXL, 结构, 权重, Flux
knowledge_cards.content:
【SD 正向结构（逗号分隔标签式）】
(质量词), (主体+特征), (动作/姿态), (服装/材质), (环境), (光线), (构图/镜头), (风格), (色彩)

【权重语法】
(词:1.3) 加权；[词] 减弱；(词) 小幅加强

【可直接复制示例】
(masterpiece, best quality, ultra detailed), 1girl, long silver hair, white dress, standing in flower field, looking at viewer, (golden hour lighting:1.2), depth of field, film grain, warm color palette

【Flux / 新一代模型建议】
Flux 偏好自然语言完整句子而非标签堆叠：
A photograph of a young woman with long silver hair in a white dress, standing in a flower field at golden hour, shallow depth of field, shot on 85mm film.

knowledge_cards.title: 通用负向提示词集合（SD 系）
knowledge_cards.keywords: negative prompt, 负向, 通用
knowledge_cards.content:
【通用负向（可直接复制）】
lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, missing fingers, extra digits, fewer digits, cropped, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, username, blurry

【人像加用】
deformed face, asymmetric eyes, long neck, extra limbs, mutated hands, poorly drawn face

【风景加用】
overexposed, oversaturated, frame, border, out of frame

【注意】
SDXL/Flux 对长负向列表敏感度下降；Flux 通常建议少用或不用负向，把要求写进正向描述。

knowledge_cards.title: MiniMax H3 视频提示词结构模板
knowledge_cards.keywords: H3, MiniMax, 视频提示词, 分段, 运镜
knowledge_cards.content:
【H3 视频提示词结构（参照官方 skill 提炼）】
1) 分镜分段：每段 5 秒以内，写清 主体+动作+环境+运镜+情绪
2) integrated_multimodal_description：一句话整合画面与声音的综合描述
3) overall_soundscape：整体声音设计（环境音、音效、音乐风格）
4) 镜头语言用词：push in / pull out / pan left / orbit / handheld / dolly zoom

【可直接复制骨架】
[0-5s] 特写：少女抬头，霓虹灯在瞳孔中闪烁，镜头缓慢推近
[5-10s] 全景：镜头环绕少女一周，城市雨夜车流划过
integrated_multimodal_description: 雨夜霓虹都市中，少女回眸，镜头从特写环绕拉出至全景，冷暖光交织
overall_soundscape: 细密雨声、远处车流、低沉合成器配乐渐入

knowledge_cards.title: 视频与运镜提示词词汇库（通用）
knowledge_cards.keywords: 视频, 运镜, 镜头, camera movement
knowledge_cards.content:
【运镜词库（英文提示词直接用）】
dolly in（推近）/ pull back（拉远）/ pan left-right（横摇）/ tilt up-down（俯仰）
orbit around subject（环绕）/ crane shot（升降）/ handheld shaky（手持晃动）/ steadicam follow（稳定跟随）
slow motion（慢动作）/ time-lapse（延时）/ zoom burst（急推）

【光线时段】
golden hour / blue hour / overcast soft light / harsh noon sun / moonlight / candlelight

【示例片段】
slow dolly-in toward the subject, golden hour backlight, gentle lens flare, cinematic color grading

knowledge_cards.title: 写实人像摄影提示词模板
knowledge_cards.keywords: 人像, portrait, 写实, 模板
knowledge_cards.content:
【可复制模板】
editorial portrait photograph of {主体}, {表情/姿态}, {服装}, {环境背景}, shot on Canon EOS R5, 85mm f/1.4, shallow depth of field, natural window light, skin texture detail, color graded --ar 4:5

【填空示例】
editorial portrait photograph of an elderly fisherman, weathered face, gentle smile, wearing yellow raincoat, harbor background at dawn, shot on 85mm f/1.4, soft overcast light, film grain --ar 4:5

【要点】
真实感靠：机身/镜头型号 + 光圈景深 + 皮肤质感 + 光线描述；避免堆砌画质词。

knowledge_cards.title: 产品与电商图提示词模板
knowledge_cards.keywords: 产品, 电商, product, 商业摄影
knowledge_cards.content:
【可复制模板】
commercial product photography of {产品}, {材质细节}, on {背景/台面}, {布光方案}, studio lighting, soft box reflections, minimalist composition, 8k commercial advertising shot

【示例】

knowledge_cards.title: 光线与时段词汇库
knowledge_cards.keywords: 光线, lighting, 时段, 词汇
knowledge_cards.content:
【按氛围选光线】
温暖治愈：soft golden hour light, warm rim light, gentle glow
冷峻科技：cold blue moonlight, neon rim lighting, hard shadows
悬疑戏剧：chiaroscuro lighting, single window light, deep shadows, low key
清新自然：overcast diffused light, morning mist, backlit haze
舞台感：spotlight from above, dramatic side lighting, volumetric beams

【组合公式】
{光线类型} + {方向} + {强度} + {色温}
例：soft golden hour backlight with warm 3200K tone

knowledge_cards.title: 镜头与构图词汇库
knowledge_cards.keywords: 镜头, 构图, 景别, composition
knowledge_cards.content:
【景别】extreme close-up / close-up / medium shot / full shot / wide shot / establishing shot
【角度】low angle（仰拍气势）/ high angle（俯拍渺小）/ dutch angle（倾斜不安）/ bird's eye / eye level
【构图】rule of thirds / centered composition / leading lines / symmetrical / negative space / frame within frame
【镜头感】85mm portrait / 35mm reportage / macro detail / anamorphic widescreen / fisheye

【示例】
low angle medium shot, rule of thirds, leading lines of railway tracks, 35mm reportage style

knowledge_cards.title: 色彩与调色词汇库
knowledge_cards.keywords: 色彩, 调色, palette, 色调
knowledge_cards.content:
【经典配色方向】
teal and orange（好莱坞大片）/ pastel muted（莫兰迪）/ neon magenta-cyan（赛博朋克）
monochrome black and white（黑白）/ sepia vintage（复古棕）/ high contrast vivid（高饱和大片）

knowledge_cards.title: 图标 / LOGO / UI 设计提示词模板
knowledge_cards.keywords: logo, 图标, UI, 设计
knowledge_cards.content:
【LOGO】
minimalist vector logo of {主题}, flat design, geometric shapes, {1-2 色描述}, white background --ar 1:1 --no realistic photo details

【App 图标】

【UI 界面】

knowledge_cards.title: 故事板 / 分镜脚本提示词模板
knowledge_cards.keywords: 分镜, storyboard, 故事板, 脚本
knowledge_cards.content:
【单张分镜】
storyboard sketch, {景别}, {角色动作}, {场景}, rough pencil lines with grey marker shading, film storyboard panel --ar 16:9

【连环分镜】
four-panel storyboard sequence: 1) establishing wide shot of {场景} 2) medium shot of {角色入场} 3) close-up of {关键道具} 4) reaction shot, consistent character design across panels

【要点】
多格时强调 consistent character design 保持角色一致；逐格写清景别与动作。

knowledge_cards.title: 负面提示词与避坑清单（MJ/SD 通用）
knowledge_cards.keywords: 避坑, 负向, 排错, 技巧
knowledge_cards.content:
【常见翻车点与解法】
1) 手指畸形 → SD 加 bad hands, extra fingers；MJ 用 --no deformed hands 或升级版本
2) 文字乱码 → 提示词里明确 no text, letters；或后期加字
3) 画面太乱 → 降低 --c/--s；减少风格词数量
4) 主体太小 → 加 subject in foreground, centered composition
5) 过度磨皮塑料感 → 加 skin texture, film grain，减画质词
6) 色彩过饱和 → 加 muted colors, natural color grading

【好习惯】
一次只改一个变量；固定 --seed 做 A/B 对比；把满意的配方存进知识库。
